Overview

Holstebro is a city in Central Jutland with a population of 37,000. A cultural center in western Jutland, known for its modern art museum, sculpture park, and theater. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
